description: Public holidays for a country and year, from the free Nager.Date API. Returns the date, local and English names, and the subdivision the holiday applies to. When an agent needs this data as a clean, typed, pay-per-call API rather than integrating the upstream itself. Do not use when the buyer needs the upstream's raw, unnormalised payload, or a write to the upstream — this product is read-only. Example requests: public holidays in the UK in 2026 | which countries does the holiday calendar cover

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

params.description: A JSON object of the operation's parameters, e.g. {"country_code": "GB", "operation": "for_year_country", "year": "2026"}. The operation and its parameters are validated before any upstream call.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.

name: submit_uk_public_holidays
title: Public Holidays
